# Vendored from Kitsas (kitupiikki)

These files are copied from the open-source Kitsas desktop app
<https://github.com/artoh/kitupiikki> so Tilari can create a schema-24
`.kitsas` book. Same license as Tilari: GNU GPL-3.0-or-later.

| File | Upstream |
|------|----------|
| `luo.sql` | `kitsas/sqlite/luo.sql` (schema 24) |
| `yritys.json` | `kitsas/tilikartat/yritys.kitsaskartta` |

Do not edit `luo.sql` except to refresh from upstream. Chart JSON is the
compiled Kitsas business chart (`VakioTilikartta` = `yritys`).

Kitsas Oy does not support Tilari. This copy does not make Tilari a Kitsas Oy
product.
